paragraphs.text: Triskelavite is a unique creature type for a type of artifact creature which only appears on tokens .
Triskelavus debuted as a type in Time Spiral on tokens created by Triskelavus . It had its first token card printed with the release of Commander Anthology Volume II .
An avite is an artifact creature created by one of the 4 "avus" constructs . Other avites are Pentavites and Tetravites .
